validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (high, real): This is MGS-3 Package 9 - a new-build 56-inch EWJZG-1 trunk line from BGCS-10 to Sector I STS-2, 458 km. Three independent sources name it exactly. MEED (primary trade press, the source the sheet already cites) lists the full MGS-3 package table: 'Package 9: Laying 56-inch EWJZG-1 from BGCS-10 to sector one STS-2, covering 458km.' Oil & Gas News (OGN, project tracker): 'The project scope involves the laying of 56-inch EWJZG-1 from BGCS-10 to sector I STS 2, covering 458km' with construction-progress detail. DMS Projects (independent project database): dedicated PRJ00030610 record, same package/length/diameter. Not GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION (correct): a 56-inch sales-gas trunk of Aramco's Master Gas System - PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas are right (this is a mainline, not a lateral; the lateral packages 12-15 are the smaller-diameter clusters). DUPLICATE (checked, NOT a duplicate): P6729=Pkg 9 (BGCS-10->STS-2, 458km), P6730=Pkg 10 (STS-2->STS-1, 310km), P6731=Pkg 11 (STS-1->Shoqaiq, 462km) are three consecutive DISTINCT segments of the same EWJZG-1 line, each a different physical stretch. Unlike the earlier East-West packages 3-8 (two parallel loops 3&4, each split into two ProjectIDs e.g. P6717/P6718), EWJZG-1 is a single line so GEM correctly carries ONE ProjectID per package. 458 km is unique to Package 9 among the 22 roster rows - no relabel/double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct (Aramco owns/operates the MGS). Main EPC A.Hak International; automatic-welding subcontractor Qapqa (OGN). Contract value ~$47M (OGN). Endpoints BGCS-10 (a new booster gas compression station built under Pkg 2 near EWPS-10) -> Sector I STS-2 - currently blank except country, staged as a fill. Province left blank: BGCS-10 sits at the western side of the East-West corridor and EWJZG-1 runs westward toward Shoqaiq (Red Sea), but no source cleanly states this segment's province (OGN says 'various locations'), so not asserting one. SPEC: diameter 56 in and length 458 km both agree across MEED+OGN+DMS. StartYear1 2028 = the MGS-3 network in-service target (Q4 2028, per Aramco's 2024 strategic-gas contract-award release the sheet cites); OGN lists a 1Q-2026 package completion target - i.e. pipe-laying done ~2026, gas flowing 2028 - so 2028 is defensible as the in-service year. Capacity not disclosed per package (MGS-3 adds ~3.2 bscfd network-wide, not attributed per segment) - left blank, not fabricated. All checked points corroborated at >=2 independent sources.
